# Erdos.p371 — Erdős problem 371

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/371
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/371.lean`, theorem `erdos_371`, AMS 11).

Let $P(n)$ denote the largest prime factor of $n$. Show that the set of $n$
with $P(n+1) > P(n)$ has density $\frac{1}{2}$.

## Statement
{ n | Nat.maxPrimeFac (n + 1) > Nat.maxPrimeFac n }.HasDensity (1/2)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
